data.title: SSN Age and Issuance Mismatch — Synthetic Identity Indicator
data.description: Detects credit applications where the SSN characteristics are inconsistent with the applicant's stated identity — a primary indicator of synthetic identity fabrication. Key signals: (1) SSN issued after the applicant's date of birth suggests the SSN belongs to someone else (minors, immigrants, recently deceased), (2) post-2011 randomized SSNs that don't match SSA area number geography, (3) SSN first appearing at credit bureaus within the last 18 months combined with an applicant age > 25 (natural credit profiles start appearing at 18-22). The eCBSV (electronic Consent Based SSN Verification) service can confirm SSN-name-DOB matches, but adoption is inconsistent.

detection.condition: selection_application AND (applicant_stated_age > 25 AND credit_file_age_months < 18) OR (ssn_issue_year_estimated > applicant_birth_year) OR (applicant_stated_age < 16 AND credit_inquiry_exists = true)

enrichment_required.source: SSA issuance year estimation (pre-2011 area-group-serial; post-2011 randomized)
Credit bureau inquiry — months since credit file creation
Credit bureau — whether any prior inquiries exist for this SSN

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for SSN Age and Issuance Mismatch")`
`comment("Detects synthetic identity via SSN-DOB-credit file inconsistencies")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:account_onboarding
  event_type="CREDIT_APPLICATION"
| eval ssn_dob_gap = ssn_issue_year_estimated - applicant_birth_year
| eval risk_indicator = case(
    applicant_stated_age > 25 AND credit_file_age_months < 18, "late_credit_file",
    ssn_issue_year_estimated > applicant_birth_year, "ssn_postdates_birth",
    applicant_stated_age < 16 AND credit_inquiry_exists="true", "minor_ssn_with_credit",
    1=1, "none")
| where risk_indicator != "none"
| table applicant_id, application_date, applicant_stated_age,
        credit_file_age_months, ssn_issue_year_estimated,
        applicant_birth_year, ssn_dob_gap,
        risk_indicator, address, device_fingerprint
| sort - application_date
queries.sql:
-- SQL for SSN Age and Issuance Mismatch
-- Detects synthetic identity via SSN-DOB-credit file inconsistencies
SELECT
  a.applicant_id,
  a.application_date,
  DATEDIFF(YEAR, a.applicant_stated_dob, CURRENT_DATE) AS applicant_stated_age,
  e.credit_file_age_months,
  e.ssn_issue_year_estimated,
  YEAR(a.applicant_stated_dob) AS applicant_birth_year,
  (e.ssn_issue_year_estimated - YEAR(a.applicant_stated_dob)) AS ssn_dob_gap,
  CASE
    WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, a.applicant_stated_dob, CURRENT_DATE) > 25
         AND e.credit_file_age_months < 18 THEN 'late_credit_file'
    WHEN e.ssn_issue_year_estimated > YEAR(a.applicant_stated_dob)
         THEN 'ssn_postdates_birth'
    WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, a.applicant_stated_dob, CURRENT_DATE) < 16
         AND e.credit_inquiry_exists = 1 THEN 'minor_ssn_with_credit'
  END AS risk_indicator,
  a.address,
  a.device_fingerprint
FROM credit_applications a
JOIN applicant_enrichment e ON a.applicant_id = e.applicant_id
WHERE a.event_type = 'CREDIT_APPLICATION'
  AND (
    (DATEDIFF(YEAR, a.applicant_stated_dob, CURRENT_DATE) > 25 AND e.credit_file_age_months < 18)
    OR (e.ssn_issue_year_estimated > YEAR(a.applicant_stated_dob))
    OR (DATEDIFF(YEAR, a.applicant_stated_dob, CURRENT_DATE) < 16 AND e.credit_inquiry_exists = 1)
  )
ORDER BY a.application_date DESC

references: Federal Reserve, Synthetic Identity Fraud in the U.S. Payment System (2024)
SSA, Electronic Consent Based SSN Verification (eCBSV) Service
TransUnion, Synthetic Identity Detection via SSN Anomaly Analysis (2025)
falsepositives: Recent immigrants who obtained SSNs later in life (legitimate late credit file)
Young adults with limited credit history applying for first credit products
Data entry errors in date of birth fields
